question: Determine when competing eligible simplicial contacts can select one cut owner and what the source hard gates establish about abort.
assumptions: A finite relabeling group, equivariant eligibility and one required contact on the prepared orbit.
The replay abstracts edge eligibility to graph controls and declares separate complete-context witnesses.
Supplied hard-gate histories and reciprocal identity-amplitude abort for the kinematic controls.

fitted_choices: Declared candidate actuator and scope of cut controls without an empirical fit

result: An exclusive equivariant selector exists on a prepared orbit exactly when its eligible contacts include a point fixed by the prepared-state stabilizer. Positive odd stock permits contexts without any fixed contact. The hard-gate product evaluates supplied factor histories and leaves native abort and cut authority open.
next_discriminant: Test whether admitted same-operator contacts can spend one cell-level capability in a symmetric batch without confusing different operators or typed vetoes.
